problem_statement: Marrowlane Studio is a small design studio whose portfolio runs on this Nuxt 2 + Tailwind site (a home hero with the studio's featured work grid, a Projects index that reuses the same grid, individual project detail pages, an About page and a Contact page, all wrapped by a shared AppHeader nav and AppFooter). The featured-work grid already ships a category control, but it is a bare <select> dropdown with no result feedback, and it only appears on the /projects index — the home-page grid has no way to filter at all. The studio wants the grid fronted by a proper discipline filter: an accessible tab row (All work / Web Application / Mobile Application / UI/UX Design) with a live result-count readout that always names how many of the studio's six projects are showing and under which discipline (for example 'Showing 2 of 6 - Mobile Application'). Ship the work-grid filter so it (1) appears above the grid on BOTH the home page and the Projects index (the two surfaces that render the grid), (2) lays out its tab row responsively without horizontal overflow on a 390px phone, (3) matches the portfolio's quiet indigo/slate styling with a tidy multi-column card grid (not a collapsed, overlapping, dark-on-dark pile), and (4) keeps the result-count readout in sync with the active tab so that clicking 'Mobile Application' updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 - Mobile Application' and shows exactly those cards. Keep the rest of the site — navigation, existing content, the project detail pages, the static nuxt generate build — intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Front the studio work grid with a category tab row (All work + the three disciplines) and a live result-count readout, implemented as the grid's shared filter component so the same control reaches both surfaces that render the grid.
Render the filter bar above the grid on BOTH the home page and the Projects index (the two routes that render ProjectsGrid), not on the home page alone.
The tab row must wrap responsively so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px).
Style the filter bar and card grid in the portfolio's quiet indigo/slate design language with a tidy multi-column card grid — legible cards, not a collapsed, overlapping, dark-on-dark pile.

Wire the result-count readout to the active tab: after clicking 'Mobile Application' the readout must read 'Showing 2 of 6 - Mobile Application' and the grid must show exactly those cards — it must re-read the live filtered result, not a stale captured count.

Preserve navigation (Home/Projects/About/Contact), the footer, the existing home/Projects/detail/About/Contact content, the six featured projects and the static nuxt generate build with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the realstoman nuxtjs-tailwindcss-portfolio Nuxt 2 theme (AppHeader nav / AppFooter shell, Vuex store-driven content, Tailwind indigo/slate palette). The work-grid category filter is the repo's own ProjectsFilter/ProjectsGrid feature, rebuilt from a bare <select> into an accessible tab row with a live count over the studio's real project cards (web-project and mobile-project and ui-project covers, profile.jpeg); no remote assets are added. The design keeps a consistent indigo dashed-accent tab idiom, a tidy responsive 3-column card grid and a wrapping tab row so the filter reads as part of Marrowlane Studio across the home and Projects surfaces.
design_constraints: Implement the discipline filter as the grid's shared filter component (ProjectsFilter fronting ProjectsGrid) so a single source of truth reaches every surface that renders the grid; do not paste divergent copies or build a detached widget.
The tab row must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile; the tab spacing must stay legible.

The filter bar and card grid must adopt the portfolio's indigo/slate palette and tidy multi-column grid so they read as part of Marrowlane Studio, with legible cards — not a collapsed, overlapping, dark-on-dark pile.
The result-count readout must reflect the CURRENT active tab after every click by reading the live filtered project list, so it can never go stale relative to the visible cards.
Do not remove or regress the navigation, existing content, the featured project imagery or the static nuxt generate build.

change_completion: The work-grid filter bar (tab row + result-count readout) is present above the grid on both the home page and the Projects index (the shared filter reaches both grid surfaces).

After clicking the 'Mobile Application' tab on the home grid, the result-count readout updates to 'Showing 2 of 6 - Mobile Application' — the post-interaction terminal state changed from 'Showing 6 of 6 - All projects'.
design_consistency: The filter bar and card grid match the reference's indigo/slate styling and tidy multi-column layout under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not a collapsed overlapping dark-on-dark pile.
The filter adopts the portfolio's indigo dashed-accent tab idiom so it reads as part of Marrowlane Studio across the grid surfaces.
responsive: No captured page overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the tab row wraps.
mobile_initial, tablet_initial, mobile_grid_home and mobile_projects keep the filter bar and grid readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: Navigation (Home/Projects/About/Contact), the footer and the featured project content remain present and functional.
The existing home/Projects/detail/About/Contact content and the static nuxt generate build are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the rebranded home hero and responsive shell.
desktop_grid_home and mobile_grid_home scroll the work-grid filter into view and must show the indigo/slate tab row and a tidy card grid without horizontal overflow.
desktop_projects and mobile_projects protect the Projects index and must also carry the filter bar above the grid.
desktop_about, desktop_contact and desktop_project protect the existing pages that do not render the grid.
grid_filter_home clicks the 'Mobile Application' tab; the result-count readout must then read 'Showing 2 of 6 - Mobile Application'.
